note: AP-E-A2e: A2d replicated on DEEP-10M (96-d float32, L2), 2000 queries. One search point per system near recall 0.96 (DiskANN Ls60 0.9608, LAANN Ls45 0.9600, PipeANN Ls60 0.9602, Starling Ls45 0.9593). Pair 1 at T8 only, pair 2 at T1 and T8.
